name: H5 Data Centers Ashburn

profile.reading: This H5 Data Centers facility is located at 21800 Beaumeade Circle, Ashburn, Virginia 20147, in the Northern Virginia data center corridor. The operator own facility page describes a 255,000 square foot new build with access to 42 MW from Dominion Power and up to 60 MVA available, built to a Tier III, N plus 2C design. The page states a targeted LEED Silver certification along with SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 compliance.
